methods.name: Quest skip to level 30
methods.note: The Restless Ghost, Priest in Peril, Recruitment Drive and Holy Grail give 14,531 XP for level 30. The ironman guide's nine-quest list reaches 37.

methods.name: Gilded altar, dragon bones
methods.note: Both burners lit for 350% XP, 2,550 bones an hour clicking each bone. Your own altar needs 75 Construction, or use a host's house at Rimmington.

methods.name: Gilded altar, your own bones
methods.note: Ironmen cannot use other players' altars. Rate is for dragon bones with both burners lit. Bank at the Camelot chest on a PvP world or use Phials.

methods.name: Chaos altar, dragon bones
methods.note: Level 38 Wilderness. 350% XP and half the bones are saved, so double the XP per bone. Rate is one inventory a trip, then dying. 860k with noted bones.

methods.name: Ensouled bloodveld heads
methods.note: Expert Reanimation at the Dark Altar, 220 heads an hour. Demon and hellhound heads in the same tier give up to 264k. Ironmen save heads from Slayer.

methods.name: Ensouled dragon heads
methods.note: Reanimate and kill them by the Dark Altar, 220 heads an hour with high combat stats. Less effort than an altar and no Wilderness. Buy heads in advance.

methods.name: Ectofuntus
methods.note: 400% XP per bone but slow: grind the bones, collect slime, worship. The safe choice for hardcore ironmen before a gilded altar. No rate in either guide.

methods.name: Sinister Offering, dragon bones
methods.note: Arceuus spell that offers three bones a cast for 300% XP with no banking. One blood and one wrath rune a cast. Also 108k Magic XP an hour. Late game for ironmen.

methods.name: Cremating urium remains
methods.note: Shades of Mort'ton with redwood pyre logs. Slow XP but usually profitable and the fastest way to zealot's robes. 57k with the hard Morytania diary.

methods.name: Libation bowl, banked bone shards
methods.note: The Teomat. Offer shards you already hold with blessed sunfire wine. Shards also come from Moons of Peril, rumours and calcified rocks. Shard making not counted.

methods.name: Libation bowl, dragon bones to shards
methods.note: Unnote, bless and chisel dragon bones, then offer with sunfire wine. 1,700 bones an hour all in. More XP per bone than a gilded altar. Usable from 30, slower.

methods.name: Gilded altar, superior dragon bones
methods.note: Same method with superior dragon bones, which need 70 Prayer. The fastest Prayer XP without Wilderness risk and the most expensive.

methods.name: Chaos altar, superior dragon bones
methods.note: Same altar with superior dragon bones. 1.05m dying after each inventory, up to 1.8m bringing noted bones and risking them to PKers.

methods.name: Pest Control points
methods.note: Spend commendation points on Prayer XP. About 40k at level 80 with 8 points a game from hard combat achievements. Usable from 25 but far slower.

unverified: Quest skip to level 30: one-off quest XP, so no hourly rate (xph 0)
Gilded altar, dragon bones: 643,000 assumes 2,550 bones an hour with manual clicking (1,070 an hour if not); a main without 75 Construction needs a host's altar, which req cannot express
Gilded altar, your own bones: the Ironman Guide gives no rate, the main guide's dragon bone figure is used; lighting burners also needs 30 Firemaking
Chaos altar, dragon bones: 500,000 is the suicide-per-inventory figure and the Ironman Guide's 'around 500,000'; 'up to 860,000' with noted bones; the comparison table says 504,000
Ensouled heads (both): table rates assume 220 heads an hour, described as 'up to 220' with high combat stats; the Ironman Guide calls the method slow and unpredictable and gives no rate
Ectofuntus: no rate in either guide (xph 0)

Sinister Offering, dragon bones: 388,800 is the table formula 216 x 600 casts x 3 bones; no Prayer level is needed for dragon bones, the Ironman Guide places offering spells at 70-99 because wrath runes need 95 Runecraft
Cremating urium remains: 95 Firemaking is the level the guide quotes for urium remains; the Shades of Mort'ton quest requirement is not stated in the guide

Libation bowl, banked bone shards: bands are the sunfire wine column for offering ready-made shards only (blessed wine is 670,000 at 30 up to about 1,114,000 at 88); 1,370,000 at 88 is the midpoint of 1,320,000-1,420,000; the guide calls these estimates
Libation bowl, dragon bones to shards: 591,600 is the comparison-table all-in rate, which assumes 62+ Prayer; the method works from 30 but no all-in rate is given below 62, so lv is set to 62
Gilded altar and Chaos altar, superior dragon bones: superior dragon bones need 70 Prayer; text and table differ slightly (1,340,000 vs 1,338,750)
Pest Control points: the guide only gives 'around 40k' at about level 80 with 8 points a game; usable from 25 but no rate, so lv is set to 80
Not included: calcified rocks (2,200 shards an hour, 11,000-13,200 banked Prayer XP, 41 Mining) and Demonic Offering on ashes (abyssal ashes 459,000 an hour by the table formula, 84 Magic)
